about.title: Two ways to make scent part of everyday life.
about.paragraph1: Our perfume collection is built around character, memory and the intimate way a fragrance settles on skin. Each composition has its own story, from warm gourmand depth to bright aromatic freshness.
about.paragraph2: Our home fragrances shape the atmosphere of a room with clear, familiar scent directions. Together, the two collections make it easy to choose a fragrance for yourself or for the spaces around you.

w301.name: Vanille Harmony
w301.headline: Where sweetness meets elegance
w301.shortDescription: An enveloping unisex composition where creamy vanilla, luminous flowers and golden amber meet with measured elegance.
story: Some fragrances simply remain on your skin; others change the moment you are in. Vanille Harmony reimagines vanilla's familiar sweetness through the elegance of flowers and the warmth of amber, creating an entrancing story that reaches the senses.

The first impression is the velvety texture of an exotic orchid. Jasmine's bright, graceful character joins the creamy warmth of vanilla to create an opening that feels soft yet compelling on the skin.

At the heart, the inviting sweetness of sugar meets the warm, almond-like nuances of tonka bean. This rich pairing takes the fragrance beyond an ordinary vanilla interpretation and gives it depth, sophistication and an irresistible character.

Golden amber emerges in the final movement with mysterious patchouli and skin-close musk. What remains is an elegant signature that is noticed without shouting, grows more beautiful at close range and leaves a mark on the memory.
Vanille Harmony is for those who do not hide their sweetness, but carry it with elegance.

g302.name: Velvet Storm
g302.headline: The trace elegance leaves on skin
g302.shortDescription: Quiet, powder-soft and memorable: a silky floral composition with iris, heliotrope and clean musk.
story: Quiet, powdery and unforgettable. Some women enter a room without needing to speak for attention; their presence is already felt. This fragrance draws inspiration from that natural elegance, free from display.
Orange blossom appears first with a bright, clean texture. A fine, lively touch of pink pepper brings unexpected energy to this graceful opening, like strength concealed beneath softness.

At the heart rises the noble, powdery beauty of iris. Surrounded by lilac, hyacinth and wisteria, this refined centre becomes a silky floral bouquet on the skin through heliotrope's almond-like, creamy warmth. It feels nostalgic without belonging to the past, romantic without ever becoming ordinary.

In the final movement, the pure softness of rice powder joins the skin-like warmth of musk. It recalls clean skin, a freshly pressed white shirt and the flawless feeling of a fine cloud of powder left behind.
Not showy, but compelling. Not intense, but indispensable. A fragrance that becomes more beautiful as you come closer and remains in the memory after you leave.
True elegance is felt before it is seen and remembered after it is gone.

f201.name: Latafa Yara
f201.headline: A pink dream on the skin
f201.shortDescription: Creamy, joyful and captivating, with tropical fruits, velvety flowers, vanilla and sandalwood.
story: Creamy, joyful and irresistibly attractive. Some fragrances recall a memory; others make you imagine a beautiful moment that has never happened. This one gathers sun-warmed tropical fruits, velvety flowers and soft vanilla inside a pink dream.

Mandarin's lively brightness is felt first. The exotic elegance of orchid and heliotrope's powdery, almond-like texture wrap around that freshness, turning it into a soft, feminine opening: sweet but never childish, vivid yet graceful.

At the heart, ripe tropical fruits combine with a creamy gourmand accord. Recalling a fruit dessert prepared on a sunny island, it creates an appetising, entrancing warmth on the skin and a feeling of happiness that softens with every breath and becomes more inviting up close.

Creamy vanilla then joins clean, skin-close musk. Sandalwood gives the composition smooth depth and balances its sugared side with elegance, leaving a warm, soft and unforgettable trail that feels like an embrace.
Neither entirely innocent nor overly assertive; neither only sweet nor only floral. It is made for women who carry their own light and leave joy and elegance wherever they go.
Some forms of beauty are not seen; they are felt like a pink dream blooming on the skin.

c101.name: SAUVAGE
c101.headline: Beyond boundaries
c101.shortDescription: A fresh, aromatic and woody composition with bergamot, pepper, lavender and a mineral amber trail.
story: A fragrance for men who refuse to fit their freedom within boundaries drawn by others. Strength does not always need to announce itself. Sometimes it is felt in a single look, a calm stance and an unforgettable trace left behind.

Inspired by the modern man who chooses his own path and is noticed through presence alone, the fragrance opens with the sharp, energetic freshness of Calabrian bergamot. Black pepper gives the vivid citrus texture a strong, striking character: fresh, clear and decisive.

At the heart, the spicy heat of Sichuan and pink pepper meets the aromatic cleanliness of lavender. Geranium and elemi bring a polished brightness while vetiver and patchouli reveal the firm, earthy strength beneath the composition.

Finally, ambroxan's mineral amber warmth becomes clear on the skin. Dry, masculine cedar and the resinous depth of labdanum complete the fragrance with a powerful signature, leaving a trail that is as charismatic as it is fresh, and as timeless as it is modern.
For men who do not wait for approval, do not turn from their path and draw strength from their bearing rather than their voice.
Some men do not adapt to the crowd; they change the atmosphere wherever they enter.
c101.heartNotes: Sichuan pepper · Pink pepper · Lavender · Geranium · Vetiver · Patchouli · Elemi

f167.name: YSL LIBRE
f167.headline: The elegance of contrasts
f167.shortDescription: A confident floral-aromatic composition balancing lavender, orange blossom, vanilla, musk and woods.
story: A fragrance for women who do not conceal their strength or give up their elegance. A woman can be both bold and graceful, distant and irresistibly attractive, because true character never fits a single mould.

Inspired by women who carry every contrast within them in perfect harmony, the fragrance begins with mandarin's lively glow and bergamot's fresh energy. Dark blackcurrant gives the opening seductive depth, while lavender adds a confident, unconventional signature.

Warm, radiant orange blossom rises at the heart. Jasmine's sensual elegance meets lavender's aromatic coolness to establish a compelling balance between femininity and strength, revealing determination beneath softness and courage inside elegance.

Madagascan vanilla then wraps the skin in creamy warmth. Skin-close musk meets the strength of cedar and the deep radiance of ambergris, leaving a sophisticated signature that changes the atmosphere and is difficult to forget.
For women who do not explain who they are, who know what they want and shape their lives through their own choices rather than the expectations of others.
True elegance is not following the rules; it is creating your own stance.

okyanus.name: Okyanus
okyanus.headline: A clear, ocean-inspired atmosphere
okyanus.shortDescription: A fresh home fragrance inspired by open water and the clean feeling of sea air.
story: Okyanus brings a crisp, airy character to the room. Its ocean-inspired direction is designed for spaces where you want the atmosphere to feel clear, cool and refreshed.

lavanta.name: Lavanta
lavanta.headline: A calm lavender atmosphere
lavanta.shortDescription: A softly aromatic home fragrance shaped around the familiar character of lavender.
story: Lavanta gives the room a calm, gently aromatic presence. Its lavender-inspired direction suits quiet corners, evening routines and spaces where a softer atmosphere feels right.

sandal.name: Sandal Ağacı
sandal.headline: A warm, wood-inspired atmosphere
sandal.shortDescription: A warm home fragrance inspired by the smooth, grounded character of sandalwood.
story: Sandal Ağacı brings a warm, grounded mood into the room. Its sandalwood-inspired direction is suited to welcoming living spaces and moments that call for a composed atmosphere.

mango.name: Mango
mango.headline: A bright, fruit-inspired atmosphere
mango.shortDescription: A cheerful home fragrance inspired by the juicy, sunlit character of ripe mango.
story: Mango gives the room a bright, easygoing energy. Its fruit-inspired direction brings a cheerful accent to everyday spaces.
